blind_spots_patched: The baseline dossier relied on unqualified statutory audits and omitted SEBI Monitoring Agency reports (CARE Ratings on IPO proceeds; Infomerics on Rights Issue proceeds), the cost-plus-10% unmapped EPC advance structure to Pansen Engineering, and the October 2026 Maharashtra State GST Section 67 search at the Mumbai registered office.

Baseline ch-6 left the 20.10 percentage-point promoter ownership drop (67.90% to 47.80%) unverified and did not audit promoter open-market sales, minimal promoter participation in the rights issue, rapid serial equity dilution, face-value ESOP grants, or the CEO's dismissal of cash-flow and ESOP accounting.

Baseline ch-2 compared only FY24 peer PAT margins from the RHP and overlooked how backward-integrated Indian majors (SRF, Gujarat Fluorochemicals, Navin Fluorine) are simultaneously expanding domestic R-32/HFO capacity to 4x India's demand while generating 25%–34% operating margins in the exact same Q2 FY27 quarter where Stallion's core spread compressed below 10%, as well as Stallion's lack of upstream AHF integration in Bhilwara Phase 1 and non-exclusive Honeywell distribution.

Baseline ch-3 and ch-4 covered the Kigali treaty but completely omitted India's anti-dumping duty (ADD) on Chinese R-32 imports, DGTR's 18 September 2026 five-year sunset review continuation recommendation petitioned by domestic rivals, and the real-world inability to enforce contractual FX pass-through clauses with customers.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: September 2026 (Q2 FY27) 2.20% operating margin and 57.22% tax rate were unexplained in baseline filings.
BROKEN: Bhilwara 10,000 MTPA R-32 plant would complete by end-December 2026 (adding partial FY27 revenue vs ₹250 crore earlier discussed) and Mambattu would start by end-2026.
CONFIRMED: Khalapur 1,200 MTPA high-purity helium / specialty-gas facility was under construction and expected to start commercial operations in the coming quarter (as of Aug 2026).
WEAKENED: FY26 operating cash flow turnaround (₹39.36 crore) and ₹433.67 crore post-rights-issue treasury lowered near-term funding-squeeze risk.
WEAKENED: Bhilwara HFO plant would begin construction in 2027 ahead of the 1 January 2028 Kigali HFC freeze.
